note: 49 individual manual composition decisions. 42 HUD crops enlarge readable heads while retaining horns/halos; 7 full-body decisions retain compact or multi-arm silhouettes. Original image pixels, white background and full references are preserved. CPU 72px review only; GPU acceptance remains pending.

creature_dragnar_fire.intent: Enlarges red face and intact horns; wing tips, tail and lower body deliberately outside head-and-chest portrait.

creature_dragnar_gale.intent: Enlarges green face, swept horns and chest; the long wind tail and wing tips are deliberately omitted.

creature_dragnar_light.intent: Keeps complete thin halo, horns and gold face; wider head window than fire preserves the ring.
